description: This file implements functions related to console forwarding in the Cuttlefish project, including generating console access info and setting up pipes for console communication.

methods.name: ConsoleInfo
methods.description: Returns a string with instructions to access the console or indicates if the serial console is disabled.

methods.name: ConsoleForwarder
methods.description: Sets up pipes and commands for forwarding console input and output, returning a command object if the console is enabled.
